headline: Mirae Asset launches target-date mutual fund for 2056 retirement
hook: Automatic allocation shift for 2056 retirement planning
summary: Mirae Asset Life Cycle Fund 2056 offers an automatic 30-year glide path that shifts investments from equities to debt, arbitrage, and gold over time. The fund operates across five distinct stages, starting with a 70–90% net equity exposure in its early years. As the target year of 2056 approaches, equity exposure systematically drops to 10–25% to protect the accumulated capital. This structure provides retail investors with a hands-off retirement solution that automatically rebalances risk as they age.
why_it_matters: Automates risk reduction for long-term retirement savings through 2056.

headline: Mirae Asset NYSE FANG+ ETF FoF delivers 39% five-year CAGR
hook: US tech fund leads five-year returns
summary: The Mirae Asset NYSE FANG+ ETF FoF has achieved a 39% CAGR over the last five years, driven by the US tech stock rally. Despite this performance, the fund experienced a significant decline in 2022. Analysts suggest maintaining caution regarding international exposure due to current market volatility and valuation premiums. A balanced domestic equity portfolio is recommended for long-term stability.
why_it_matters: International diversification carries high volatility and valuation risks for Indian investors.
winners_losers: Long-term tech investors gain / new entrants face risk
